faqs.question: How long must I use this kit to see results?
faqs.answer: You will notice visible reduction in pigmentation with 3 months of use. With severe underarm pigmentation: changes depend on the severity of the condition. We recommend speaking to an expert for your speicific case.

faqs.question: What are the side effects of this kit?
faqs.answer: There are no side effects. However, we always recommend you to do a patch test before using any skincare product for the first time.

faqs.question: Can I use these products directly post-waxing?
faqs.answer: We'd suggest keeping a gap of 6-12 hours to use these products post waxing.

faqs.question: Why should I use this kit?
faqs.answer: Enriched with 1% Mandelic Acid and 2% Urea, this kit will fade severe underarm pigmentation over time

faqs.question: Can I use the roll on twice a day?
faqs.answer: We recommend you to use your Roll On in AM routine and Pigmentation Repair Cream in PM routine

faqs.question: Will Roll On leave patches on clothes?
faqs.answer: No, if you allow the product to absorb before wearing clothes, it won't leave patches.

faqs.question: Can I use Pigmentation Repair Cream on face?
faqs.answer: The formulation of the cream is made for body skin. We do not recommend using it one face

faqs.question: How long should we keep the Pigmentation Repair cream after applying it ?
faqs.answer: This is a leave in fromulation, hence we do not recommend washing this cream post application. Keep it as long as possible and wait for the cream to absorb.

faqs.question: Can We Apply Roll-on After Shaving Underarms?
faqs.answer: Applying underarm roll-on after shaving is generally safe, but it is important to wait a few minutes after shaving to allow the skin to heal and avoid irritation. Shaving can cause small cuts and abrasions on the skin, increasing the risk of irritation and infection. Applying a roll-on immediately after shaving can also cause stinging or burning sensations, as the skin is more sensitive. To avoid irritation and discomfort, it is recommended to wait at least 10-15 minutes after shaving before applying an underarm roll-on.
